name: 🔥 Steal a Animal 🦁
description:
🔥 STEAL animals from other bases and build the richest zoo!

🆕 STEAL A ANIMAL UPDATE: 20 animals from Chick and Bunny to Lion, Unicorn and the SECRET Dragon! Sneaky BOTS now guard their bases and try to steal YOUR animals - slap them to get them back (code ANIMAL)!

✅ Theft insurance 25% + 90s REVENGE
⭐ FUSE 3 identical animals into ★ animals
🌈 Golden, Diamond and Rainbow mutations (up to x10)
🎉 FREE server events every 8 minutes
🥚 Eggs, daily quests, lucky wheel, expeditions and a free Animal Pass
👫 +10% cash per friend in your server, invite rewards
🛡️ Newbie shield, slap thieves, lock your base, rebirth

Can you find the Secret Dragon?
